title: Seetha asks Hanuma to describe the characteristics
introduction: Seetha asks Hanuma to describe the various characteristics of Rama and Lakshmana. Hanuma describes n detail to Seetha the appearance and qualities of Rama and Lakshmana. Hanuma also gives an account of how a friendship developed between Rama and Lakshmana as well as Sugreeva the Lord of monkeys. Hanuma also narrates his own life-story from the time he was born till his role as a minister of Sugreeva. He ends the story with his sight of Seetha in Lanka.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 35th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तु राम कथाम् श्रुत्वा वैदेही वानर ऋषभात् |
उवाच वचनम् सान्त्वम् इदम् मधुरया गिरा
verses.iast:
tām tu rāma kathām śrutvā vaidehī vānara ṛṣabhāt |
uvāca vacanam sāntvam idam madhurayā girā
verses.translation: Hearing that narration about Rama from Hanuma the excellent of monkeys, Seetha in a sweet voice spoke the following gentle words:

glosses.meaning: from Hanuma the excellent of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
क्व ते रामेण संसर्गः कथम् जानासि लक्ष्मणम् |
वानराणाम् नराणाम् च कथम् आसीत् समागमः
verses.iast:
kva te rāmeṇa saṃsargaḥ katham jānāsi lakṣmaṇam |
vānarāṇām narāṇām ca katham āsīt samāgamaḥ
verses.translation: "Where was your contact with Rama? How do you know Lakshmana? How did the union between monkeys and men arise?"

verses.devanagari:
यानि रामस्य लिन्गानि लक्ष्मणस्य च वानर |
तानि भूयः समाचक्ष्व न माम् शोकः समाविशेत्
verses.iast:
yāni rāmasya lingāni lakṣmaṇasya ca vānara |
tāni bhūyaḥ samācakṣva na mām śokaḥ samāviśet
verses.translation: "O Hanuma! What are the characteristics of Rama and Lakshmana? Narrate them to me, so that sorrow will not take possession of me again."

verses.devanagari:
कीदृशम् तस्य संस्थानम् रूपम् रामस्य कीदृशम् |
कथम् ऊरू कथम् बाहू लक्ष्मणस्य च शंस मे
verses.iast:
kīdṛśam tasya saṃsthānam rūpam rāmasya kīdṛśam |
katham ūrū katham bāhū lakṣmaṇasya ca śaṃsa me
verses.translation: "Of what kind was the appearance of that Rama and of Lakshmana? Of what kind was their form? How were the thighs? How were the arms? Tell me."

glosses.meaning: and of Lakshmana? kiidR^isham = of what kind was

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु वैदेह्या हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
ततो रामम् यथा तत्त्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu vaidehyā hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ |
tato rāmam yathā tattvam ākhyātum upacakrame
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Seetha, Hanuma, the son of wind-god, then started to describe Rama according to his actual state (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
जानन्ती बत दिष्ट्या माम् वैदेहि परिपृच्छसि |
भर्तुः कमल पत्र अक्षि सम्ख्यानम् लक्ष्मणस्य च
verses.iast:
jānantī bata diṣṭyā mām vaidehi paripṛcchasi |
bhartuḥ kamala patra akṣi samkhyānam lakṣmaṇasya ca
verses.translation: "O Seetha having eyes resembling lotus leaves! By my fortune, you are enquiring about the appearance of Rama your husband and Lakshmana, eventhough you know about them. Alas! what a pleasure!"

verses.devanagari:
यानि रामस्य चिह्नानि लक्ष्मणस्य च यानि वै |
लक्षितानि विशाल अक्षि वदतः शृणु तानि मे
verses.iast:
yāni rāmasya cihnāni lakṣmaṇasya ca yāni vai |
lakṣitāni viśāla akṣi vadataḥ śṛṇu tāni me
verses.translation: "O the large eyed Seetha! I tell the characteristics of Rama and Lakshmana as I recognized them; hear them from me."

verses.devanagari:
रामः कमल पत्र अक्षः सर्व भूत मनो हरः |
रूप दाक्षिण्य सम्पन्नः प्रसूतो जनक आत्मजे
verses.iast:
rāmaḥ kamala patra akṣaḥ sarva bhūta mano haraḥ |
rūpa dākṣiṇya sampannaḥ prasūto janaka ātmaje
verses.translation: "O Seetha the daughter of Janaka! Rama has his eyes resembling the petals of a lotus. He has a handsomeness, attracting the hearts of all living beings. He is endowed with grace and dexterity, by birth."

glosses.meaning: O Seetha the daughter of Janaka!
has his eyes resembling the petals of a lotus
He is endowed with grace and dexterity
from the time he was born.

verses.devanagari:
तेजसा आदित्य सम्काशः क्षमया पृथिवी समः |
बृहस्पति समो बुद्ध्या यशसा वासव उपमः
verses.iast:
tejasā āditya samkāśaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivī samaḥ |
bṛhaspati samo buddhyā yaśasā vāsava upamaḥ
verses.translation: "He is equal to the sun in splendour, earth in endurance, Brihaspati in intelligence and Indra in fame."

glosses.meaning: he is equal to the sun

verses.devanagari:
रक्षिता जीव लोकस्य स्व जनस्य च रक्षिता |
रक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य धर्मस्य च परम् तपः
verses.iast:
rakṣitā jīva lokasya sva janasya ca rakṣitā |
rakṣitā svasya vṛttasya dharmasya ca param tapaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama the tormentator of his adversaries, is a protector of the world of beings, further protecting his own people. He is the protector of his own behaviour and righteousness.

verses.devanagari:
रामो भामिनि लोकस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता |
मर्यादानाम् च लोकस्य कर्ता कारयिता च सः
verses.iast:
rāmo bhāmini lokasya cāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā |
maryādānām ca lokasya kartā kārayitā ca saḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Rama is the protector of the four castes of the world. He is the doer and also the agent for the people's propriety of conduct."
notes: * Four principal castes described in Manu's code - Brahmanas (priestly class), Kshatriyas (members of military or reigning order); Vaisyas (Traders and agriculturists) and Sudras (class of servitude).

verses.devanagari:
अर्चिष्मान् अर्चितो अत्यर्थम् ब्रह्म चर्य व्रते स्थितः |
साधूनाम् उपकारज्ञः प्रचारज्ञः च कर्मणाम्
verses.iast:
arciṣmān arcito atyartham brahma carya vrate sthitaḥ |
sādhūnām upakārajñaḥ pracārajñaḥ ca karmaṇām
verses.translation: "Rama is a resplendent man. He is respected exceedingly. He is established in a vow of chastity. He knows how to do good to virtuous people. He knows the application and advantage of his actions."

glosses.meaning: He knows how to do good
He knows the application and advantage

verses.devanagari:
राज विद्या विनीतः च ब्राह्मणानाम् उपासिता |
श्रुतवान् शील सम्पन्नो विनीतः च परम् तपः
verses.iast:
rāja vidyā vinītaḥ ca brāhmaṇānām upāsitā |
śrutavān śīla sampanno vinītaḥ ca param tapaḥ
verses.translation: "He is well trained in statesmanship. He honours brahmins, the priestly class. He possesses sacred knowledge. He is endowed with good conduct. He is a modest man. He torments his adversaries."

glosses.meaning: He is well trained in statesmanship
He is endowed with a good conduct

verses.devanagari:
यजुः वेद विनीतः च वेदविद्भिः सुपूजितः |
धनुः वेदे च वेदे च वेद अन्गेषु च निष्ठितः
verses.iast:
yajuḥ veda vinītaḥ ca vedavidbhiḥ supūjitaḥ |
dhanuḥ vede ca vede ca veda angeṣu ca niṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: "He got trained in Yajurveda, the sacrificial Veda. He is highly honoured by those well-versed in Vedas. He is skilled in Dhanurveda, the science of archery, other Vedas and the six limbs* of Vedangas."
notes: Six limbs of Vedangas : 1) Siksha, the science of proper articulaton and pronunciation 2) Chandas, the metre 3) Vyakarana, the grammar 4) Nirukta, the explanation of difficult Vedic words 5) Jyotisha, the astronomy or rather the Vedic Calendar. 6) Kalpa, the ceremonial represented by a large number of Sura works.

glosses.meaning: and the six limbs of Vedangas.

verses.devanagari:
विपुल अंसो महाबाहुः कम्बु ग्रीवः शुभ आननः |
गूढ जत्रुः सुताम्र अक्षो रामो देवि जनैः श्रुतः
verses.iast:
vipula aṃso mahābāhuḥ kambu grīvaḥ śubha ānanaḥ |
gūḍha jatruḥ sutāmra akṣo rāmo devi janaiḥ śrutaḥ
verses.translation: "O princess! Rama is a broad shouldered and a long-armed man. He has a shell-like neck. He has a handsome countenance. He has a hidden collar-bone. He has beautiful red eyes. His fame is heard about by people."

verses.devanagari:
दुन्दुभि स्वन निर्घोषः स्निग्ध वर्णः प्रतापवान् |
समः सम विभक्त अन्गो वर्णम् श्यामम् समाश्रितः
verses.iast:
dundubhi svana nirghoṣaḥ snigdha varṇaḥ pratāpavān |
samaḥ sama vibhakta ango varṇam śyāmam samāśritaḥ
verses.translation: "He has a voice like the sound of a kettle-drum. He has a shining skin. He is full of splendour. He is square-built. His limbs are built symmetrically. He is endowed with a dark-brown complexion."

glosses.meaning: He has a voice like the sound of a kettle-drum

verses.devanagari:
त्रिस्थिरः त्रिप्रलम्बः च त्रिसमः त्रिषु च उन्नतः |
त्रिवलीवान् त्र्यवनतः चतुः व्यन्गः त्रिशीर्षवान्
verses.iast:
tristhiraḥ tripralambaḥ ca trisamaḥ triṣu ca unnataḥ |
trivalīvān tryavanataḥ catuḥ vyangaḥ triśīrṣavān
verses.translation: "He is ever firm in three limbs (viz. the breast, waist and fist), long in three (viz. the breast, waist and fist), long in three (viz. the eyebrows, arms and soles), uniform in three (viz. his locks, testical and knees, elevated in three (viz. his breast, rim of his navel and lower abdomen), coppery in three of the navel and the lower abdomen), coppery in three (viz. the rims of his eyes, nails, palms and soles), soft in three (viz. the lines on his soles, hair and the end of the membrane virile) and always deep in three (viz. the voice, gait and the navel)."

glosses.meaning: He is ever firm in three limbs (viz. the breast
coppery in three (viz. the rims of his eyes
soft in three (viz. the lines on his soles

verses.devanagari:
त्रिवलीवांस्त्र्यवनतश्चतुर्व्यङ्गस्त्रिशीर्षवान् |
चतुष्कलश्चतुर्लेखश्चतुष्किष्कुश्चतुःसमः
verses.iast:
trivalīvāṃstryavanataścaturvyaṇ^gastriśīrṣavān |
catuṣkalaścaturlekhaścatuṣkiṣkuścatuḥsamaḥ
verses.translation: "He has three folds in the skin of his neck and belly. He is depressed at three places (viz. the middle of his soles, the lines on his soles and the nipples). He is undersized at four places (viz. the neck, membran virile, the back and the shanks). He is endowed with three spirals in the hair of his head. He has four lines at the root of his thumb (denoting his proficiency in the four Vedas). He has four lines on his forehead (indicating longevity). He is four cubits high (96 inches). He has four pairs of limbs (viz. the cheeks, arms, shanks and knees) equally matched."

glosses.meaning: He has three folds (in the skin of his neck and belly)
He is depressed at three places (viz. the middle of his soles
undersized at four place (viz. the neck
He is endowed with three spirals in the hair of his head
He has four marks on his thumb (denoting his proficiency in the four Vedas)
He has four lines on his forehead (indicating longevity)

verses.devanagari:
चतुष् कलः चतुः लेखः चतुष् किष्कुः चतुः समः |
चतुर्दश सम द्वन्द्वः चतुः दष्टः चतुः गतिः
verses.iast:
catuṣ kalaḥ catuḥ lekhaḥ catuṣ kiṣkuḥ catuḥ samaḥ |
caturdaśa sama dvandvaḥ catuḥ daṣṭaḥ catuḥ gatiḥ
verses.translation: "He has fourteen other pairs of limbs (viz. the eye brows, nostrils, eyes, ears, lips, nipples, elbows, wrists, knees testicles, lions, hands, feet and thighs) equally matched. The four large teeth at both the ends of his upper and lower jaws are very sharp. He walks in four gaits (resembling the walks of a lion, a tiger, an elephant and a bull). He is endowed with excellent lips, chin and nose. He has five glossy limbs (viz. the hair, eyes, teeth, skin and soles). He has eight long limbs (viz. the arms, fingers and toes, eyes and ears, thighs and shanks).

glosses.meaning: He has fourteen other pairs of limbs (viz. the eye brows
the four large teeth at both the ends of his upper and lower jaws are very sharp

He is endowed with excellent lips

He has eight long limbs (viz. the arms

verses.devanagari:
दश पद्मो दश बृहत् त्रिभिः व्याप्तो द्वि शुक्लवान् |
षड् उन्नतो नव तनुः त्रिभिः व्याप्नोति राघवः
verses.iast:
daśa padmo daśa bṛhat tribhiḥ vyāpto dvi śuklavān |
ṣaḍ unnato nava tanuḥ tribhiḥ vyāpnoti rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama has ten lotus-like limbs (viz. the countenance, the mouth, the eyes, the tongue, lips, palate, breasts, nails, the hands and the feet). He has ten ample limbs (viz. the chest, the head, the forehead, the neck, the arms, the heart, the mouth the feet, the back and the ears). He is spread through by reason of three (viz. splendour, renown and glory). He is doubly pure (on father's and mother's side). He is elevated in six limbs (viz. the flanks, the abdomen, the breast, the nose, the shoulders and the forehead). He is small, thin, fine or sharp in nine (viz. the hair, the moustaches and the beard, nails the hair on the body, the skin, the finger-joints, the membrum virile, acumen and perception). He pursues religious merit, worldly riches and the sensuous delight in three periods (viz. the forenoon, midday and afternoon).

glosses.meaning: has ten lotus-like limbs (viz. the countenance
He has ten ample limbs (viz. the chest
He is doubly pure (on father's and mother's side)
He is elevated in six limbs (viz the flanks

verses.devanagari:
सत्य धर्म परः श्रीमान् सम्ग्रह अनुग्रहे रतः |
देश काल विभागज्ञः सर्व लोक प्रियम् वदः
verses.iast:
satya dharma paraḥ śrīmān samgraha anugrahe rataḥ |
deśa kāla vibhāgajñaḥ sarva loka priyam vadaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama is engrossed in truth and righteousness. He is a prosperous man. He is interested in reception and facilitation. He knows how to apportion place and time. He speaks affectionately with all."

glosses.meaning: Rama is engrossed in truth and righteousness
He knows apportioning of place and time

verses.devanagari:
भ्राता च तस्य द्वैमात्रः सौमित्रिः अपराजितः |
अनुरागेन रूपेण गुणैः चैव तथा विधः
verses.iast:
bhrātā ca tasya dvaimātraḥ saumitriḥ aparājitaḥ |
anurāgena rūpeṇa guṇaiḥ caiva tathā vidhaḥ
verses.translation: "The invincible Lakshmana, the son of Rama's step-mother and Rama's brother, is resembling Rama in appearance, affection and in qualities."

glosses.meaning: in appearance guNaishchaiva = and in qualities.

verses.devanagari:
तावुभौ नरशार्डूलौ त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकौ |
विचिन्वनौ महीम् कृत्स्नामस्माभिरभिसम्गातौ
verses.iast:
tāvubhau naraśārḍūlau tvaddarśanasamutsukau |
vicinvanau mahīm kṛtsnāmasmābhirabhisamgātau
verses.translation: "Rama and Lakshmana, the two tigers among men, very anxiously desirous of seeing you and searching all over the earth, came in contact with us."

glosses.meaning: very anxiously desirous of seeing you

verses.devanagari:
त्वाम् एव मार्गमाणो तौ विचरन्तौ वसुम् धराम् |
ददर्शतुः मृग पतिम् पूर्वजेन अवरोपितम्
ऋश्यमूकस्य पृष्ठे तु बहु पादप सम्कुले |
भ्रातुः भार्य आर्तम् आसीनम् सुग्रीवम् प्रिय दर्शनम्
verses.iast:
tvām eva mārgamāṇo tau vicarantau vasum dharām |
dadarśatuḥ mṛga patim pūrvajena avaropitam
ṛśyamūkasya pṛṣṭhe tu bahu pādapa samkule |
bhrātuḥ bhārya ārtam āsīnam sugrīvam priya darśanam
verses.translation: "Those two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, wandering only in search of you all over the earth, saw Sugreeva the Lord of monkeys, sitting on the top of Rishyamuka mountain, filled with several trees, having been dethroned by his elder brother, oppressed with fear, but who was pleasant to the sight."

glosses.meaning: on the top of R^ishyamuka mountain
and who was pleasant to the sight.

verses.devanagari:
वयम् तु हरि राजम् तम् सुग्रीवम् सत्य सम्गरम् |
परिचर्यामहे राज्यात् पूर्वजेन अवरोपितम्
verses.iast:
vayam tu hari rājam tam sugrīvam satya samgaram |
paricaryāmahe rājyāt pūrvajena avaropitam
verses.translation: "We for one are serving that Sugreeva, the Lord of monkeys, who was true to his promise, but was dethroned from the kingdom from his elder brother."

glosses.meaning: who was true to his promise

verses.devanagari:
ततः तौ चीर वसनौ धनुः प्रवर पाणिनौ |
ऋश्यमूकस्य शैलस्य रम्यम् देशम् उपागतौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ tau cīra vasanau dhanuḥ pravara pāṇinau |
ṛśyamūkasya śailasya ramyam deśam upāgatau
verses.translation: "In the meanwhile, those two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, wearing clothes made of bark and arming the best bows, came to the charming place of Rishyamuka mountain."

verses.devanagari:
स तौ दृष्ट्वा नर व्याघ्रौ धन्विनौ वानर ऋषभः |
अभिप्लुतो गिरेः तस्य शिखरम् भय मोहितः
verses.iast:
sa tau dṛṣṭvā nara vyāghrau dhanvinau vānara ṛṣabhaḥ |
abhipluto gireḥ tasya śikharam bhaya mohitaḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing Rama and Lakshmana, the excellent of men, coming with bows in hand, that Sugreeva the best of monkeys was deluded with fear and jumped over to the hill-top of that mountain."

verses.devanagari:
ततः स शिखरे तस्मिन् वानर इन्द्रो व्यवस्थितः |
तयोः समीपम् माम् एव प्रेषयामास सत्वरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa śikhare tasmin vānara indro vyavasthitaḥ |
tayoḥ samīpam mām eva preṣayāmāsa satvaraḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, stationed on that hill-top, that Sugreeva the lord of monkeys, very soon sent me only, to approach those two brothers."

verses.devanagari:
ताव् अहम् पुरुष व्याघ्रौ सुग्रीव वचनात् प्रभू |
रूप लक्षण सम्पन्नौ कृत अञ्जलिः उपस्थितः
verses.iast:
tāv aham puruṣa vyāghrau sugrīva vacanāt prabhū |
rūpa lakṣaṇa sampannau kṛta añjaliḥ upasthitaḥ
verses.translation: "On that command of Sugreeva, I reached saluting those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana the excellent and capable men, endowed with good form and characteristics."

glosses.meaning: as per the words of Sugreeva
and endowed with a good form and characteristics.

verses.devanagari:
तौ परिज्ञात तत्त्व अर्थौ मया प्रीति समन्वितौ |
पृष्ठम् आरोप्य तम् देशम् प्रापितौ पुरुष ऋषभौ
verses.iast:
tau parijñāta tattva arthau mayā prīti samanvitau |
pṛṣṭham āropya tam deśam prāpitau puruṣa ṛṣabhau
verses.translation: "Those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, the excellent among men, were fully endowed with kindness, after knowing the exact position about Sugreeva. Then, I made Rama and Lakshmana to ascend on my back and took them to Sugreeva's place."

glosses.meaning: having known the exact position (about Sugreeva)
that place (where Sugreeva and others were present).

verses.devanagari:
निवेदितौ च तत्त्वेन सुग्रीवाय महात्मने |
तयोः अन्योन्य सम्भाषात् भृशम् प्रीतिः अजायत
verses.iast:
niveditau ca tattvena sugrīvāya mahātmane |
tayoḥ anyonya sambhāṣāt bhṛśam prītiḥ ajāyata
verses.translation: "I informed the high-souled Sugreeva about the true position of Rama and Lakshmana. After a mutual conversation between those two brothers and Sugreeva, a great friendship developed among them."

glosses.meaning: the true state (about Rama and Lakshman)

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तौ प्रीतिसंपन्नौ हरि ईश्वर नर ईश्वरौ |
परस्पर कृत आश्वासौ कथया पूर्व वृत्तया
verses.iast:
tatastau prītisampannau hari īśvara nara īśvarau |
paraspara kṛta āśvāsau kathayā pūrva vṛttayā
verses.translation: "Thus endowed with friendship, Sugreeva the lord of monkeys and Rama the best of men, by talking together of their earlier occurrences, developed mutual confidence."

glosses.meaning: Sugreeva the lord of monkeys and Rama

verses.devanagari:
तम् ततः सान्त्वयामास सुग्रीवम् लक्ष्मण आग्रजः |
स्त्री हेतोः वालिना भ्रात्रा निरस्तम् उरु तेजसा
verses.iast:
tam tataḥ sāntvayāmāsa sugrīvam lakṣmaṇa āgrajaḥ |
strī hetoḥ vālinā bhrātrā nirastam uru tejasā
verses.translation: "Thereafter, that Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana, through the extremely effulgent Vali the brother of Sugreeva, consoled Sugreeva who was earlier expelled from the kingdom; (by Vali), for the sake of Ruma a woman."

glosses.meaning: who was expelled (from the kingdom by Vali)

verses.devanagari:
ततः त्वन् नाशजम् शोकम् रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः |
लक्ष्मणो वानर इन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tvan nāśajam śokam rāmasya akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ |
lakṣmaṇo vānara indrāya sugrīvāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: "Then, Lakshmana informed Sugreeva the king of monkeys about the sadness of Rama, (who is unwearied in action), born out of your disappearance."

verses.devanagari:
स श्रुत्वा वानर इन्द्रः तु लक्ष्मणेन ईरितम् वचः |
तदा आसीन् निष्प्रभो अत्यर्थम् ग्रह ग्रस्त इव अंशुमान्
verses.iast:
sa śrutvā vānara indraḥ tu lakṣmaṇena īritam vacaḥ |
tadā āsīn niṣprabho atyartham graha grasta iva aṃśumān
verses.translation: "Hearing the words of Lakshmana, Sugreeva then became highly dim-witted, as the sun becomes dim when overpowered by an eclipse."

verses.devanagari:
ततः त्वत् गात्र शोभीनि रक्षसा ह्रियमाणया |
यानि आभरण जालानि पातितानि मही तले
तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरि यूथपाः |
सम्हृष्टा दर्शयाम् आसुः गतिम् तु न विदुः तव
verses.iast:
tataḥ tvat gātra śobhīni rakṣasā hriyamāṇayā |
yāni ābharaṇa jālāni pātitāni mahī tale
tāni sarvāṇi rāmāya ānīya hari yūthapāḥ |
samhṛṣṭā darśayām āsuḥ gatim tu na viduḥ tava
verses.translation: "Thereafter, all those multitude of ornaments which adorned your body, which were being tried to be be snatched away by Ravana and which were dropped on to the earth, were brought by monkey-leaders joyfully and shown to Rama. But the monkey-leaders did not know the further course of your movement."

glosses.meaning: and which were being snatched away

verses.devanagari:
तानि रामाय दत्तानि मया एव उपहृतानि च |
स्वनवन्ति अवकीर्णन्ति तस्मिन् विहत चेतसि
verses.iast:
tāni rāmāya dattāni mayā eva upahṛtāni ca |
svanavanti avakīrṇanti tasmin vihata cetasi
verses.translation: "I indeed brought those ornaments near to Rama and gave them to him. Then, soon after receiving them, Rama lost his consciousness and the resounding ornaments were scattered all over."

verses.devanagari:
तानि अन्के दर्शनीयानि कृत्वा बहु विधम् ततः |
तेन देव प्रकाशेन देवेन परिदेवितम्
verses.iast:
tāni anke darśanīyāni kṛtvā bahu vidham tataḥ |
tena deva prakāśena devena paridevitam
verses.translation: "That Lord Rama looking like god, kept those beautiful ornaments of yours in his flank and lamented in many ways."

verses.devanagari:
पश्यतः तस्या रुदतः ताम्यतः च पुनः पुनः |
प्रादीपयन् दाशरथेः तानि शोक हुत अशनम्
verses.iast:
paśyataḥ tasyā rudataḥ tāmyataḥ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
prādīpayan dāśaratheḥ tāni śoka huta aśanam
verses.translation: "While seeing those ornaments, Rama was lamenting and getting suffocated again and again. Thus, those ornaments ignited the fire of Rama's grief."

verses.devanagari:
शयितम् च चिरम् तेन दुह्ख आर्तेन महात्मना |
मया अपि विविधैः वाक्यैः कृच्छ्रात् उत्थापितः पुनः
verses.iast:
śayitam ca ciram tena duhkha ārtena mahātmanā |
mayā api vividhaiḥ vākyaiḥ kṛcchrāt utthāpitaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: "That grief-stricken mighty man was thus lying on the floor for a long time. Then, with great difficulty, I made him to get up by telling several consoling words."

glosses.meaning: was again made to get up

verses.devanagari:
तानि दृष्ट्वा महाअर्हाणि दर्शयित्वा मुहुः मुहुः |
राघवः सह सौमित्रिः सुग्रीवे स न्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
tāni dṛṣṭvā mahāarhāṇi darśayitvā muhuḥ muhuḥ |
rāghavaḥ saha saumitriḥ sugrīve sa nyavedayat
verses.translation: "That long-armed Rama, along with Lakshmana, after seeing those ornaments, examined them, again and again. He later gave them to Sugreeva."

verses.devanagari:
स तव अदर्शनात् आर्ये राघवः परितप्यते |
महता ज्वलता नित्यम् अग्निना इव अग्नि पर्वतः
verses.iast:
sa tava adarśanāt ārye rāghavaḥ paritapyate |
mahatā jvalatā nityam agninā iva agni parvataḥ
verses.translation: "O the kind mistress! As you were being unseen, Rama was tormented forever with a great flaming fire of grief, like a volcano."

glosses.meaning: with a great flaming fire (of grief)

verses.devanagari:
त्वत् कृते तम् अनिद्रा च शोकः चिन्ता च राघवम् |
तापयन्ति महात्मानम् अग्नि अगारम् इव अग्नयः
verses.iast:
tvat kṛte tam anidrā ca śokaḥ cintā ca rāghavam |
tāpayanti mahātmānam agni agāram iva agnayaḥ
verses.translation: "For your sake, insomnia, grief and worry were tormenting that great souled Rama, as flames torment a burning house."

verses.devanagari:
तव अदर्शन शोकेन राघवः प्रविचाल्यते |
महता भूमि कम्पेन महान् इव शिला उच्चयः
verses.iast:
tava adarśana śokena rāghavaḥ pravicālyate |
mahatā bhūmi kampena mahān iva śilā uccayaḥ
verses.translation: "By the grief caused by your not being seen, Rama is trembled with grief, as a high mountain is trembled by a great earthquake."

verses.devanagari:
कानानानि सुरम्याणि नदी प्रस्रवणानि च |
चरन् न रतिम् आप्नोति त्वम् अपश्यन् नृप आत्मजे
verses.iast:
kānānāni suramyāṇi nadī prasravaṇāni ca |
caran na ratim āpnoti tvam apaśyan nṛpa ātmaje
verses.translation: "O princess! In not seeing you, Rama is not obtaining delight, even while moving in quite charming forests, encompassing rivers and water-falls."

glosses.meaning: while moving in suramyaaNi kaananaani = very beautiful forests

verses.devanagari:
स त्वाम् मनुज शार्दूलः क्षिप्रम् प्राप्स्यति राघवः |
समित्र बान्धवम् हत्वा रावणम् जनक आत्मजे
verses.iast:
sa tvām manuja śārdūlaḥ kṣipram prāpsyati rāghavaḥ |
samitra bāndhavam hatvā rāvaṇam janaka ātmaje
verses.translation: "O Seetha the daughter of Janaka! That Rama the excellent of men will receive you, soon after, killing Ravana along with Ravana's friends and relatives."

glosses.meaning: O Seetha the daughter of Janaka!
along with his friends and relatives.

verses.devanagari:
सहितौ राम सुग्रीवाव् उभाव् अकुरुताम् तदा |
समयम् वालिनम् हन्तुम् तव च अन्वेषणम् तथा
verses.iast:
sahitau rāma sugrīvāv ubhāv akurutām tadā |
samayam vālinam hantum tava ca anveṣaṇam tathā
verses.translation: "That day when Rama and Sugreeva were together, both of them made an agreement that Rama would annihilate Vali and Sugreeva would arrange for a search of you."

verses.devanagari:
ततस्ताभ्याम् कुमाराभ्याम् वीराभ्याम् स हरीश्वरः |
किष्किन्धाम् समूपागम्य वाली युद्धे निपातितः
verses.iast:
tatastābhyām kumārābhyām vīrābhyām sa harīśvaraḥ |
kiṣkindhām samūpāgamya vālī yuddhe nipātitaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, Rama and Lakshmana the two valiant princes reached Kishkindha. Rama killed Vali the king of monkeys there in a combat."

verses.devanagari:
ततो निहत्य तरसा रामो वालिनम् आहवे |
सर्व ऋष्क हरि सम्घानाम् सुग्रीवम् अकरोत् पतिम्
verses.iast:
tato nihatya tarasā rāmo vālinam āhave |
sarva ṛṣka hari samghānām sugrīvam akarot patim
verses.translation: "After killing Vali in combat by means of his strength, Rama made Sugreeva the king for the entire multitude of bears and monkeys."

glosses.meaning: for the entire multitude of bears and monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
राम सुग्रीवयोः ऐक्यम् देवि एवम् समजायत |
हनूमन्तम् च माम् विद्धि तयोः दूतम् इह आगतम्
verses.iast:
rāma sugrīvayoḥ aikyam devi evam samajāyata |
hanūmantam ca mām viddhi tayoḥ dūtam iha āgatam
verses.translation: "O princess! A friendship was held well in such a manner between Rama and Sugreeva. Know me as Hanuma, who came here as a messenger on behalf of both of them."

verses.devanagari:
स्व राज्यम् प्राप्य सुग्रीवः समनीय महाहरीन् |
त्वत् अर्थम् प्रेषयामास दिशो दश महाबलान्
verses.iast:
sva rājyam prāpya sugrīvaḥ samanīya mahāharīn |
tvat artham preṣayāmāsa diśo daśa mahābalān
verses.translation: "Having got his own kingdom, Sugreeva summoned for mighty as well as capable monkeys and sent them to ten different directions in search of you."

verses.devanagari:
आदिष्टा वानर इन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महाओजसः |
अद्रि राज प्रतीकाशाः सर्वतः प्रस्थिता महीम्
verses.iast:
ādiṣṭā vānara indreṇa sugrīveṇa mahāojasaḥ |
adri rāja pratīkāśāḥ sarvataḥ prasthitā mahīm
verses.translation: "As commanded by Sugreeva of a great splendour and the king of monkeys, those monkeys resembling Himalayan mountains, started out on all directions of the earth."

glosses.meaning: those monkeys resembling the king of mountains

verses.devanagari:
ततस्ते मार्गमाणा वै सुग्रीववचनातुराः |
चरन्ति वसुधाम् कृत्स्नाम् वयमन्ये च वानराः
verses.iast:
tataste mārgamāṇā vai sugrīvavacanāturāḥ |
caranti vasudhām kṛtsnām vayamanye ca vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Then, we along with other monkeys too who are eager to fulfill the command of Sugreeva, are wandering the entire earth in search of you."

glosses.meaning: who are eager to fulfill the command of Sugreeva

verses.devanagari:
अन्गदो नाम लक्ष्मीवान् वालि सूनुः महाबलः |
प्रस्थितः कपि शार्दूलः त्रिभाग बल सम्वृतः
verses.iast:
angado nāma lakṣmīvān vāli sūnuḥ mahābalaḥ |
prasthitaḥ kapi śārdūlaḥ tribhāga bala samvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "An excellent monkey named Angada, possessed of fortune, son of Vali and having great strength, taking one third of army along with him, set out in search of you."

glosses.meaning: taking one third of army (along with him).

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् नो विप्रनष्टानाम् विन्ध्ये पर्वत सत्तमे |
भृशम् शोक परीतनाम् अहो रात्र गणा गताः
verses.iast:
teṣām no vipranaṣṭānām vindhye parvata sattame |
bhṛśam śoka parītanām aho rātra gaṇā gatāḥ
verses.translation: "A number of days and nights passed, filled as we were with grief, having got lost our way intensely in a mountain-range called Vindhya."

glosses.meaning: a number of days and night
filled as we were with grief
having got lost our way intensely
in a mountain range called Vindhya.

verses.devanagari:
ते वयम् कार्य नैराश्यात् कालस्य अतिक्रमेण च |
भयाच् च कपि राजस्य प्राणान् त्यक्तुम् व्यवस्थिताः
verses.iast:
te vayam kārya nairāśyāt kālasya atikrameṇa ca |
bhayāc ca kapi rājasya prāṇān tyaktum vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: "We were determined to forsake our lives because of despair in our non-fulfillment of work, in our overstepping of time-limit given by Sugreeva and in fear of the King Sugreeva."

glosses.meaning: because of despair in our non-fulfillment of work
in our over-tapping the time-limit (given by Sugreeva)
of Sugreeva the king of monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
विचित्य वन दुर्गाणि गिरि प्रस्रवणानि च |
अनासाद्य पदम् देव्याः प्राणान् त्यक्तुम् व्यवस्थिताः
verses.iast:
vicitya vana durgāṇi giri prasravaṇāni ca |
anāsādya padam devyāḥ prāṇān tyaktum vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: "Having searched in places difficult of access in forests, at mountains and at cascades and not obtaining any indication of you the princess, we were ready to give up our lives."

glosses.meaning: in places difficult of access in forests

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा प्रायोपविष्टांश्च सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान् |
भृशम् शोक अर्णवे मग्नः पर्यदेवयत् अन्गदः
तव नाशम् च वैदेहि वालिनः च तथा वधम् |
प्राय उपवेशम् अस्माकम् मरणम् च जटायुषः
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā prāyopaviṣṭāṃśca sarvānvānarapuṇ^gavān |
bhṛśam śoka arṇave magnaḥ paryadevayat angadaḥ
tava nāśam ca vaidehi vālinaḥ ca tathā vadham |
prāya upaveśam asmākam maraṇam ca jaṭāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Seeing all the excellent monkeys sitting down and calmly awaiting for the approach of death, Angada was very much immerssed in the ocean of sorrow and lamented about your loss, the killing of Vali, the death of Jatayu and our practice of calmly awaiting for the approach of death in simply sitting down."

glosses.meaning: sitting down and calmly awaiting the approach of death
calmly awaiting for the death in simply sitting down.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् नः स्वामि संदेशान् निराशानाम् मुमूर्षताम् |
कार्य हेतोः इव आयातः शकुनिः वीर्यवान् महान्
verses.iast:
teṣām naḥ svāmi saṃdeśān nirāśānām mumūrṣatām |
kārya hetoḥ iva āyātaḥ śakuniḥ vīryavān mahān
verses.translation: "For us who lost all our hopes on our lives and willing to give up our lives as per the command of Sugreeva, as though for the sake of our need alone, a great valiant bird came there."

glosses.meaning: who lost our hopes on our lives
and willing to give up our lives
as per the command of Sugreeva
(as thought) for the sake of our need alone

verses.devanagari:
गृध्र राजस्य सोदर्यः सम्पातिः नाम गृध्र राट् |
श्रुत्वा भ्रातृ वधम् कोपात् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
gṛdhra rājasya sodaryaḥ sampātiḥ nāma gṛdhra rāṭ |
śrutvā bhrātṛ vadham kopāt idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: "Hearing about the killing of his brother, the vulture-king Sampati the brother of slain Jatayu the King of vultures spoke (the following) words in anger:

glosses.meaning: about the killing of his brother

verses.devanagari:
यवीयान् केन मे भ्राता हतः क्व च विनाशितः |
एतत् आख्यातुम् इच्छामि भवद्भिः वानर उत्तमाः
verses.iast:
yavīyān kena me bhrātā hataḥ kva ca vināśitaḥ |
etat ākhyātum icchāmi bhavadbhiḥ vānara uttamāḥ
verses.translation: "O the best of monkeys! Tell me who, where and how my younger brother Jabali was killed and made to fall."

verses.devanagari:
अन्गदो अकथयत् तस्य जन स्थाने महत् वधम् |
रक्षसा भीम रूपेण त्वाम् उद्दिश्य यथा तथम्
verses.iast:
angado akathayat tasya jana sthāne mahat vadham |
rakṣasā bhīma rūpeṇa tvām uddiśya yathā tatham
verses.translation: "Then, Angada told Sampati a detailed account of events which led tot he killing of that great bird at Janasthana, by a demon of terrific form, for your sake."

glosses.meaning: by a demon of terrific form

verses.devanagari:
जटायोः तु वधम् श्रुत्वा दुह्हितः सो अरुण आत्मजः |
त्वाम् आह स वर आरोहे वसन्तीम् रावण आलये
verses.iast:
jaṭāyoḥ tu vadham śrutvā duhhitaḥ so aruṇa ātmajaḥ |
tvām āha sa vara ārohe vasantīm rāvaṇa ālaye
verses.translation: "O Seetha with an excellent waist! Hearing about the slaughter of Jatayu, that Sampati the son of Aruna was very much pained and said that you were staying in Ravana's house."

glosses.meaning: O Seetha with an excellent waist!

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सम्पातेः प्रीति वर्धनम् |
अन्गद प्रमुखाः सर्वे ततः सम्प्रस्थिता वयम्
verses.iast:
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā sampāteḥ prīti vardhanam |
angada pramukhāḥ sarve tataḥ samprasthitā vayam
verses.translation: "Hearing those delightful words of Sampati, we with our Chief Angada started soon from there."

glosses.meaning: of that Sampaate = of that Sampati

verses.devanagari:
विन्ध्यादुत्थाय सम्प्राप्ताः सागरस्यान्तमुत्तरम् |
त्वत् दर्शन कृत उत्साहा हृष्टाः तुष्टाः प्लवम्गमाः
verses.iast:
vindhyādutthāya samprāptāḥ sāgarasyāntamuttaram |
tvat darśana kṛta utsāhā hṛṣṭāḥ tuṣṭāḥ plavamgamāḥ
verses.translation: "The monkeys were very much delighted and satisfied. They were making up their energy to see you, rose up from Vindhya mountain and reached the northern shore of the ocean."

glosses.meaning: and exercising their strength to see you

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गदप्रमुखाः सर्वे वेलोपान्तमुपस्थिताः |
चिन्ताम् जग्मुः पुनर्भीतास्त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकाः
verses.iast:
aṇ^gadapramukhāḥ sarve velopāntamupasthitāḥ |
cintām jagmuḥ punarbhītāstvaddarśanasamutsukāḥ
verses.translation: "All the monkeys with their Chief Angada, in their anxiety to see you, reached the ocean. They were frightened after seeing the ocean there and they were again worried."

glosses.meaning: the monkeys with their Chief Angada
in their anxiety to see you

verses.devanagari:
अथ अहम् हरि सैन्यस्य सागरम् दृश्य सीदतः |
व्यवधूय भयम् तीव्रम् योजनानाम् शतम् प्लुतः
verses.iast:
atha aham hari sainyasya sāgaram dṛśya sīdataḥ |
vyavadhūya bhayam tīvram yojanānām śatam plutaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, seeing the ocean, I removed the serious fears of the army of monkeys who were worrying and crossed hundred Yojanas across the sea."

verses.devanagari:
लन्का च अपि मया रात्रौ प्रविष्टा राक्षस आकुला |
रावणः च मया दृष्टः त्वम् च शोक निपीडिता
verses.iast:
lankā ca api mayā rātrau praviṣṭā rākṣasa ākulā |
rāvaṇaḥ ca mayā dṛṣṭaḥ tvam ca śoka nipīḍitā
verses.translation: "Entering even Lanka, filled with demons in the night, I saw Ravana and you too who were immersed in grief."

glosses.meaning: filled with grief (were seen by me).

verses.devanagari:
एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् यथा वृत्तम् अनिन्दिते |
अभिभाषस्व माम् देवि दूतो दाशरथेः अहम्
verses.iast:
etat te sarvam ākhyātam yathā vṛttam anindite |
abhibhāṣasva mām devi dūto dāśaratheḥ aham
verses.translation: "O the faultless princess! I told you all this as actually occurred. I am the messenger of Rama. Talk to me."

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् माम् राम कृत उद्योगम् त्वन् निमित्तम् इह आगतम् |
सुग्रीव सचिवम् देवि बुध्यस्व पवन आत्मजम्
verses.iast:
tvam mām rāma kṛta udyogam tvan nimittam iha āgatam |
sugrīva sacivam devi budhyasva pavana ātmajam
verses.translation: "O princess! I made an effort on Rama's behalf and came here for your sake. I am Sugreeva's minister. I am the son of wind-god. Know me, as such."

glosses.meaning: having made an effort on Rama's behalf

verses.devanagari:
कुशली तव काकुत्स्थः सर्व शस्त्रभृताम् वरः |
गुरोः आराधने युक्तो लक्ष्मणः च सुलक्षणः
verses.iast:
kuśalī tava kākutsthaḥ sarva śastrabhṛtām varaḥ |
guroḥ ārādhane yukto lakṣmaṇaḥ ca sulakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "You Rama, the excellent man among all the wielders of bow, is safe. Lakshmana, who is engaged in the service of his elder brother and possessing good characteristics, is also safe."

glosses.meaning: among all the wielders of bow
the service of his elder brother

verses.devanagari:
तस्य वीर्यवतो देवि भर्तुः तव हिते रतः |
अहम् एकः तु सम्प्राप्तः सुग्रीव वचनात् इह
verses.iast:
tasya vīryavato devi bhartuḥ tava hite rataḥ |
aham ekaḥ tu samprāptaḥ sugrīva vacanāt iha
verses.translation: "O princess! I, who am interested in the welfare of the valiant Rama, your husband, came here alone on the command of Sugreeva."

verses.devanagari:
मया इयम् असहायेन चरता काम रूपिणा |
दक्षिणा दिग् अनुक्रान्ता त्वन् मार्ग विचय एषिणा
verses.iast:
mayā iyam asahāyena caratā kāma rūpiṇā |
dakṣiṇā dig anukrāntā tvan mārga vicaya eṣiṇā
verses.translation: "I, who can change my form at will, desirous of finding out your access, wandering alone without any helper, came to this southern direction."

glosses.meaning: who can change my form at will
desirous of finding out your access

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या अहम् हरि सैन्यानाम् त्वन् नाशम् अनुशोचताम् |
अपनेष्यामि सम्तापम् तव अभिगम शंसनात्
verses.iast:
diṣṭyā aham hari sainyānām tvan nāśam anuśocatām |
apaneṣyāmi samtāpam tava abhigama śaṃsanāt
verses.translation: "I shall remove the anguish of the army of monkeys who are lamenting because of your disappearance by informing them about my coming close to you because of my good fortune!"

glosses.meaning: who are lamenting tvannaasham = because of your loss
by informing about my approaching you

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या हि न मम व्यर्थम् देवि सागर लन्घनम् |
प्राप्स्यामि अहम् इदम् दिष्ट्या त्वत् दर्शन कृतम् यशः
verses.iast:
diṣṭyā hi na mama vyartham devi sāgara langhanam |
prāpsyāmi aham idam diṣṭyā tvat darśana kṛtam yaśaḥ
verses.translation: "O princess! By my fortune, my crossing of ocean has not gone in vain. I can get this fame of having seen you because of my good luck."

verses.devanagari:
राघवः च महावीर्यः क्षिप्रम् त्वाम् अभिपत्स्यते |
समित्र बान्धवम् हत्वा रावणम् राक्षस अधिपम्
verses.iast:
rāghavaḥ ca mahāvīryaḥ kṣipram tvām abhipatsyate |
samitra bāndhavam hatvā rāvaṇam rākṣasa adhipam
verses.translation: "The highly valiant Rama, by killing Ravana the Lord of demons along with his friends and relatives, will obtain you soon."

glosses.meaning: along with his friends and relatives

verses.devanagari:
कौरजो नाम वैदेहि गिरीणाम् उत्तमो गिरिः |
ततो गच्छति गो कर्णम् पर्वतम् केसरी हरिः
verses.iast:
kaurajo nāma vaidehi girīṇām uttamo giriḥ |
tato gacchati go karṇam parvatam kesarī hariḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! There is a mountain called Malyavan, which is the best among mountains. From there, a monkeys called Kesari went to another mountain called Gokarna."

verses.devanagari:
स च देव ऋषिभिः दृष्टः पिता मम महाकपिः |
तीर्थे नदी पतेः पुण्ये शम्ब सादनम् उद्धरत्
verses.iast:
sa ca deva ṛṣibhiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ pitā mama mahākapiḥ |
tīrthe nadī pateḥ puṇye śamba sādanam uddharat
verses.translation: "As prayed by gods and seers, that great monkey called Kesari, my father killed a demon named Shambasadana at a sacred shrine near the sea-shore."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अहम् हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि |
हनूमान् इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेन एव कर्मणा
verses.iast:
tasya aham hariṇaḥ kṣetre jāto vātena maithili |
hanūmān iti vikhyāto loke svena eva karmaṇā
verses.translation: "O Seetha! I am born in the womb of the wife of that Kesari the monkey, by the grace of the wind-god. By my activity alone, I am renowned as Hanuma in this world."

verses.devanagari:
विश्वासार्थम् तु वैदेहि भर्तुरुक्ता मया गुणाः |
विश्वास अर्थम् तु वैदेहि भर्तुः उक्ता मया गुणाः
verses.iast:
viśvāsārtham tu vaidehi bharturuktā mayā guṇāḥ |
viśvāsa artham tu vaidehi bhartuḥ uktā mayā guṇāḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! I described the qualities of Rama, your husband, to cause trust in you. O the faultless princess! Rama will take you from here within a short time."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् विश्वासिता सीता हेतुभिः शोक कर्शिता |
उपपन्नैः अभिज्ञानैः दूतम् तम् अवगच्छति
verses.iast:
evam viśvāsitā sītā hetubhiḥ śoka karśitā |
upapannaiḥ abhijñānaiḥ dūtam tam avagacchati
verses.translation: Thus inspired by confidence because of the above reasons, Seetha emaciated with grief, by adequate clues served as proof.

verses.devanagari:
अतुलम् च गता हर्षम् प्रहर्षेण तु जानकी |
नेत्राभ्याम् वक्र पक्ष्माभ्याम् मुमोच आनन्दजम् जलम्
verses.iast:
atulam ca gatā harṣam praharṣeṇa tu jānakī |
netrābhyām vakra pakṣmābhyām mumoca ānandajam jalam
verses.translation: Seetha obtained unequal delight. She released tears of joy from her eyes having curved eye-lashes, with a thrill of delight.

verses.devanagari:
चारु तच् च आननम् तस्याः ताम्र शुक्ल आयत ईक्षणम् |
अशोभत विशाल अक्ष्या राहु मुक्त इव उडु राट्
verses.iast:
cāru tac ca ānanam tasyāḥ tāmra śukla āyata īkṣaṇam |
aśobhata viśāla akṣyā rāhu mukta iva uḍu rāṭ
verses.translation: The countenance of that large-eyed Seetha, who is beautiful, whose eyes are red white and long is shining like a moon, the king of stars liberated from Rahu the demon.

verses.devanagari:
हनूमन्तम् कपिम् व्यक्तम् मन्यते न अन्यथा इति सा |
अथ उवाच हनूमान् ताम् उत्तरम् प्रिय दर्शनाम्
verses.iast:
hanūmantam kapim vyaktam manyate na anyathā iti sā |
atha uvāca hanūmān tām uttaram priya darśanām
verses.translation: Seetha considered Hanuma clearly as a monkey and not otherwise. Thereafter Hanuma replied to her who is pleasant to the sight (as follows)

glosses.meaning: who is pleasant to the sight.

verses.devanagari:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातम् समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि |
किम् करोमि कथम् वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātam samāśvasihi maithili |
kim karomi katham vā te rocate pratiyāmyaham
verses.translation: "O Seetha! I told you indeed all this please be consoled. Tell me what I can do for you and also what is agreeable to you. I am going back now."

verses.devanagari:
हते असुरे सम्यति शम्ब सादने |
कपि प्रवीरेण महर्षि चोदनात् |
ततो अस्मि वायु प्रभवो हि मैथिलि |
प्रभावतः तत् प्रतिमः च वानरः
verses.iast:
hate asure samyati śamba sādane |
kapi pravīreṇa maharṣi codanāt |
tato asmi vāyu prabhavo hi maithili |
prabhāvataḥ tat pratimaḥ ca vānaraḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! As provoked by the sages, Kesari, the valiant monkey killed a demon called Shambasadana in battle. I am a monkey born through wind-god and through his influence I am equal to the wind-god in strength."

glosses.meaning: I am equal to the wind-god.
